suggestion_status.description: Status of the suggestion — routes workflow DECISION nodes

suggested_technician_id.description: Top candidate's technician id, null if no match

suggested_technician_name.description: Top candidate's display name, null if no match

alternatives.description: Next 1-2 best candidates with reasons they are not ranked first

assignment_rationale.description: 2-4 sentences explaining why this tech is the best fit

confidence.description: Honest confidence score: >=0.85 clear match, 0.6-0.84 moderate, <0.6 weak

no_available_tech.description: True when no candidate passes pruning

fallback_suggestion.description: Describes the coverage gap when no tech is available

score.description: Composite score for the top candidate
